description: A bug fix proves itself mechanically: Compose runs the reproduce test (or a COMP-VERIFY-FLOW-1 flow) on the base commit and on the fix commit, and records a receipt only when it fails on base and passes on head (exit codes: proved / not proved / app failed to start / failed before its assertion). Today pipelines/bug-fix.stratum.yaml:126-134 asks the agent to write a test that "must fail before any fix" but its ensure only checks outcome == complete, so the fail-on-base half is self-reported. Opt-in evidence kind bound to the completion, not a new default gate. Extends lib/completion-gate.js, lib/evidence.js, the bug-fix pipeline reproduce/verify steps; builds on COMP-VERIFY-FLOW-1. Pattern from t3code scripts/prove-scenario.ts. Notes in docs/features/COMP-VERIFY-PROVE-1/source.md
phase: COMP-VERIFY: Verification that proves the outcome (OPS-VERIFY-CONFORM-1 ruling, owner "agree all" 2026-11-17)
